other_conditions: Beneficiary must be working in an establishment registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965 and must have regular contributions received by the Board
Application must be submitted within three months from the date of delivery
Beneficiary must have been a registered member of the Board for at least six months prior to the birth of the child
Benefit is limited to the birth of two children only
Financial assistance is not provided to beneficiaries covered under ESIC
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,100 will be given to the spouse of the registered beneficiary woman employee after the child's birth.
documents_required: Birth certificate issued by the competent authority
Clear picture of both sides of the Aadhaar Card
Clear picture of the Bank Passbook
Clear pictures of all pages of the BOCW copy issued by the Board
